title: 1988 resume to Teller leads to EG&G and S-4
summary: Bob Lazar tells of 1988 resume to Teller leads to EG&G and S-4, about 1988 at Las Vegas, Nevada, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Now I never met Dr. Teller again, but 1988 when I decided to re-enter the scientific community, I sent him a resume and inquired about a job.
then you have the fact that he got Lazar his job with EG which I think you can almost definitively say at this point there's too much data there to dismiss.
tellings.difference: Told by the host as near-certain, not firsthand by Lazar, with no date and no mention of the resume.
tellings.link_reason: Teller getting Lazar his EG&G job is the same claim as the 1988 resume to Teller that led to EG&G and S-4.

as_told.title: Teller got Lazar his job with EG&G

tellings.quote: Yeah. I mean Bob Lazar got a job at EGNG.
tellings.difference: The host mentions the EG&G job only in passing, with no Teller resume, and places it around 1989.
tellings.link_reason: Both are about Lazar getting his job at EG&G, which led to S-4.

related.note: Both explain how Lazar got the S-4 job. The story credits John Lear's help, while this telling credits a 1988 resume sent to Edward Teller, so the core claims conflict.

plain: Bob Lazar, a man who says he once worked on alien craft at a secret Nevada site called S-4, says that in 1988 in Las Vegas he decided to go back into science and sent his resume to Edward Teller, a famous physicist he had met once before, asking about a job. As the story goes, this led to work through EG&G, a defense contractor, and on to S-4. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, repeats the link in passing, calling it close to certain that Teller got Lazar the job, which would matter because it would tie Lazar to real defense work.
